memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: "Now I am about to go the way of all the earth. You know with all your heart and soul that not one of all the good promises the Lord your God gave you has failed. Every promise has been fulfilled; not one has failed." — Josh 23:14 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
Joshua speaks of his own death plainly: "I am about to go the way of all the earth." Every one of us will walk that road. But listen to the testimony he leaves as he faces it: "not one of all the good promises the Lord your God gave you has failed. Every promise has been fulfilled; not one has failed."

What a thing to be able to say at the end of a long life. After decades of walking with God — through wilderness and warfare, through waiting and struggle — Joshua's settled conviction is that God kept every single word. He says it twice, so no one could miss it. Not one good promise had failed.

This is the reward of a life spent trusting God: you come to the end and find He was faithful all along. The promises that once required faith to believe are now facts you have lived to see.

We can share this same confidence, and even more so, for every promise of God finds its "Yes" in Christ (2 Cor 1:20). The forgiveness, the adoption, the eternal home He has pledged are as certain as the ground beneath your feet. When your own time comes to "go the way of all the earth," may you be able to say the same as Joshua — that God's word never failed you. Stake your life on it now.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Can you look back and see promises of God already kept in your life?
2. How does Joshua's testimony strengthen your trust for the future?
3. What promise of God do you most need to rest on today?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Faithful God, not one of Your good promises has ever failed. Help me to trust Your word completely, knowing every promise finds its Yes in Christ. Amen.
